paragraphs: Merck & Co., Inc. is an American multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in Rahway, New Jersey. The company does business as Merck Sharp & Dohme or MSD outside the United States and Canada. The company is ranked fifth on the list of largest biomedical companies by revenue.

The company's revenues are primarily from cancer treatments, vaccines, and animal health products. In 2024, 46% of the company's revenue, or $29.5 billion, came from sales of Keytruda (pembrolizumab), a PD-1 inhibitor used to treat various types of cancers, and 13% of the company's revenue, or $8.6 billion, came from sales of Gardasil, an HPV vaccine. In addition, 9% of the company's revenue, or $5.8 billion, came from the sales of animal health products.
The company is ranked 65th on the Fortune 500 and 76th on the Forbes Global 2000.

In 1891, Merck & Co. was established as the American affiliate of the Merck Group, founded by the Merck family, and the companies are still in trademark disputes in several countries over the right to use the name "Merck".

people.name: Robert M. Davis
people.title: Chairman, Chief Executive Officer and President
people.bio: Davis has served as Chief Executive Officer and President since 2021 and Chairman since 2022. Previously, he served as Merck's Chief Financial Officer and Executive Vice President, Global Services.
people.quote: Mr. Davis, the Company's Chairman, Chief Executive Officer, and President, has extensive management, financial, and operational expertise.

people.title: Executive Vice President and President, Merck Manufacturing Division
people.bio: Chattopadhyay has held his current role since March 2016. He will cease to be an executive officer on May 1, 2026, and remain in a strategic advisory role until his retirement on July 1, 2026.

people.name: Robert M. Davis
people.title: Chair of the Board
people.bio: Davis serves as Chairman of the Board and CEO of Merck. He oversees Board operations and governance matters and the general supervision, direction, and control of the Company's business, subject to Board oversight.
people.quote: Currently, the Board is led by Robert M. Davis, who serves as the Chairman of the Board and CEO of our Company

people.name: Thomas H. Glocer
people.title: Independent Lead Director
people.bio: Glocer has been Founder and Managing Partner of Angelic Ventures LP since 2012. He previously served as CEO of Thomson Reuters Corporation and Reuters Group PLC.
people.quote: Mr. Glocer has extensive management, operational, technology, and international business expertise.

people.name: Surendralal L. Karsanbhai
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Karsanbhai has served as President and Chief Executive Officer of Emerson Electric Co. since 2021, after serving as Executive President of Emerson Automation Solutions. He also chairs the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis and is a Trustee of Washington University.
people.quote: Mr. Karsanbhai has broad experience in global business leadership as President and Chief Executive Officer of Emerson Electric Co.

people.name: Risa J. Lavizzo-Mourey, M.D.
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Lavizzo-Mourey is Robert Wood Johnson Foundation Population Health and Health Equity Professor Emerita at the University of Pennsylvania. She served as President and Chief Executive Officer of the Robert Wood Johnson Foundation from 2003 to 2017.
people.quote: Dr. Lavizzo-Mourey has extensive health policy experience, serving as Robert Wood Johnson Foundation Population Health and Health Equity Professor Emerita at the University of Pennsylvania

people.name: Stephen L. Mayo, Ph.D.
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Mayo is Merkin Institute Professor and Bren Professor of Biology and Chemistry at the California Institute of Technology, where he previously served as a division chair and Vice Provost for Research. He co-founded Xencor and serves on the boards of Allogene Therapeutics and Sarepta Therapeutics.
people.quote: Dr. Mayo has extensive scientific experience relevant to the biopharmaceutical industry

people.name: Paul B. Rothman, M.D.
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Rothman served as CEO of Johns Hopkins Medicine and Dean of the Medical Faculty and Vice President for Medicine at Johns Hopkins University from 2012 to 2022. He previously served as Dean and Head of Internal Medicine at the University of Iowa's Carver College of Medicine.
people.quote: Dr. Rothman has extensive expertise in patient care, science and medicine relevant to the pharmaceutical industry

people.name: Patricia F. Russo
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Russo has served as Non-executive Chair of Hewlett Packard Enterprise since 2015 and previously led Alcatel-Lucent and Lucent Technologies. Her stated director tenure begins with Schering-Plough in 1995, which became Merck & Co., Inc. in 2009.
people.quote: Ms. Russo has extensive management, operational, international business and financial expertise, as well as a broad understanding of the technology industry

people.name: Christine E. Seidman, M.D.
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Seidman has been Thomas W. Smith Professor of Medicine and Genetics at Harvard Medical School/Brigham and Women's Hospital since 2005 and a Howard Hughes Medical Institute investigator since 1994. She also directs the Cardiovascular Genetics Center at Brigham and Women's Hospital.
people.quote: Dr. Seidman has extensive scientific experience relevant to the biopharmaceutical industry.

people.name: Inge G. Thulin
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Thulin served as Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer of 3M from 2012 to 2018 and Executive Chairman from 2018 to 2019. His earlier 3M roles included Chief Operating Officer and Executive Vice President of International Operations.
people.quote: Mr. Thulin has extensive management, operational, technology, and international business expertise, as demonstrated by a track record of success leading 3M Company.

people.name: Kathy J. Warden
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Warden serves as Chair, CEO and President of Northrop Grumman Corporation. She previously held leadership roles at General Dynamics and General Electric and is a former chair of the board of the Richmond Federal Reserve Bank.
people.quote: Ms. Warden has broad experience in operational leadership as Chair, CEO and President of Northrop Grumman Corporation
